Title: RFQ no. 2026-08-28-006_1 LOT_Procurement of Website Hosting and Technical Support Services for the Encyclopedia of Philippine Art (EPA) Digital Edition

Buyer / Organization: Cultural Center of the Philippines - Pasay City Metro Manila

Country: Philippines

Reference Number: 13217867

Procurement Type: Negotiated Procurement - Small Value Procurement (Sec. 34) / RFQ

Published: August 29, 2026

Deadline: September 1, 2026 9:00 AM (PHT)

Days Remaining: Not stated.

Budget / Contract Value: PHP 617,000.00

WHY IT FITS AISTAFF: This remains the best overall fit because it is a service-led website hosting and technical-support procurement under a small-value route, with a budget large enough to justify effort and a scope that plausibly aligns with AIStaff’s implementation, support, integrations, and operations capabilities.

WHAT THEY NEED: Not stated publicly.

ELIGIBILITY:

  • Official public abstract directs suppliers to a public RFQ document for the detailed scope and submission package
  • Public notice says quotation is due on or before September 1, 2026 at 9:00 AM to CCP Procurement Management Division
  • Post-award documents named in the abstract include signed quotation, valid Business/Mayor's Permit, PhilGEPS Registration, notarized Omnibus Sworn Statement with proof of authority if applicable, and latest 2025 annual income tax return plus business tax returns
  • Official public contacts shown in the abstract: glycidas.penaranda@culturalcenter.gov.ph, pmd@culturalcenter.gov.ph, and regie.profeta@culturalcenter.gov.ph, tel. 8551-0039
  • Public abstract still does not clearly state the required PhilGEPS membership level or any prior-project threshold

BLOCKERS / RISKS:

  • The public abstract does not summarize the actual hosting architecture, migration scope, uptime/SLA expectations, security responsibilities, or maintenance boundaries
  • The posting is still classified under Goods / General Support Services, so the buyer may still lean toward an incumbent managed-hosting vendor
  • Eligibility and technical fit still depend on the detailed RFQ, not the abstract alone

HOW WE COULD QUALIFY:

  • AIStaff direct fit not yet confirmed from the public notice.

NEXT ACTION: Review the linked RFQ immediately, confirm whether Red PhilGEPS registration is acceptable, and verify the hosting stack, uptime/support SLA, migration obligations, security responsibilities, and whether website enhancement work is included.

TODAY'S RECOMMENDATION

Best opportunity to pursue: RFQ no. 2026-08-28-006 Website Hosting and Technical Support Services for the Encyclopedia of Philippine Art (Ref 13217867) remains the best opportunity to pursue today because it is still the strongest service-led fit, carries a better budget than the new Dagupan notice, and closes on Tuesday, September 1, 2026.

Documents AIStaff should prepare: Current PhilGEPS registration and annexes; Mayor's/Business Permit and SEC registration; Notarized Omnibus Sworn Statement with proof of signatory authority; Latest 2025 annual income tax return and recent business tax returns; One-page capability sheet focused on website operations, implementation, support, AI-assisted customer service, automations, and integrations; Short hosting-and-support approach note covering uptime handling, backups, security, migration, incident response, and support process; If pursuing the UNDRR EOI, a concise Brandee AI / digital-content credentials deck focused on social media, video, branding, campaigns, and content production

Clarifications to request: For CCP: whether Red PhilGEPS registration is acceptable for this small-value RFQ; For CCP: the exact hosting stack, traffic expectations, uptime/support SLA, backup responsibilities, security scope, and whether website enhancements are included; For Dagupan: whether the requirement is simple renewal of an incumbent provider or a competitive opportunity open to a new hosting/maintenance supplier; For Dagupan: who owns the domain, hosting account, CMS/application stack, backups, and existing support credentials; For Quezon: which entity controls the detailed requirements and submissions, Province of Quezon BAC or DepEd-Quezon; For UNDRR: whether AIStaff should position for one lot only and what minimum international creative-services references are expected in the EOI stage
